there is evidence for prograde rotation of the metal-rich stellar halo of the Milky Way, the globular clusters and the dwarf spheroidal galaxies of M31 and the satellite galaxies of the Milky Way.

the stellar haloes of both the Milky Way and Andromeda are rotating and that this rotation is dominated by the metal-rich component in each case.

there is evidence for rotation of the stellar halo in the Milky Way as well as in the globular cluster and dwarf galaxy populations of the Milky Way, M31 and other galaxies.
